_milestones_comment: T-538: the EVERGREEN cadence past the last authored cosmetic tier (15). Every `cadence` best-tiers from `first_best_tier` up, a season-settle grants the next numbered ascendant title (rift_ascendant_1, _2, ...), so an infinite ladder ALWAYS has a next visible prize. Cosmetic/title only, source 'season' = EARNED (T-482 charter: bought never outranks earned). Cadence/first/prefix are owner-tunable data. `max` bounds the loop against a pathological best (server truth, but belt-and-braces).
